title: Sordland/Turn07/HOS AND BERGIA STEEL FULLY NATIONALISED

entries.menuText: “Keep the pen. A gift from me and a reminder.”

entries.dialogueText: Marcel buried his head in his hands.

entries.dialogueText: “I have already made my decision.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“If we are going down, you are goin..."
entries.dialogueText: “If we are going down, you are going down with us.”

entries.dialogueText: “With their connections and influence, they could cause us untold difficulties down the road."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti

entries.dialogueText: “I swear on my name as a Koronti.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Koronti. Mr. Tusk. Here are the agreements that pertain to the nationalization and the transfer of your shares to the state.”

entries.dialogueText: “I know everything.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk

entries.dialogueText: “This is nonsense.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Mr. President. I beg you to rethin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. I beg you to rethink this decision.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel and Walter packed their belo..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel and Walter packed their belongings and furiously exited the room, closing the door loudly.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Most of the Assembly eats out of m..."
entries.dialogueText: “Most of the Assembly eats out of my hand.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Rest assured. I will never forget..."
entries.dialogueText: “Rest assured. I will never forget what you have done to me.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti

entries.dialogueText: “Don't you realize how much dirt I have on you? You will pay for backstabbing me.”

entries.dialogueText: He pointed to various sections and pages in the stack of papers.

entries.dialogueText: “You will need to sign here, here and here.”

entries.dialogueText: “No. There is no need.”

entries.dialogueText: “Don't you realize how much dirt I have on you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I thought we had a deal!”"
entries.dialogueText: “I thought we had a deal!”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Good luck doing that behind bars.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good luck doing that behind bars.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Walter scrutinized Marcel closely."
entries.dialogueText: Walter scrutinized Marcel closely.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We *had* a deal.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We *had* a deal.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Wake up. I just used you, Marcel.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Wake up. I just used you, Marcel.”
entries.menuText: “Wake up. I just used you, Marcel.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You have exhausted your usefulness..."
entries.dialogueText: “You have exhausted your usefulness.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“You will learn what it means to hu..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will learn what it means to hurt Walter Tusk, President.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I will destroy you!”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will destroy you!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel and Walter packed their belo..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel and Walter packed their belongings and exited the room, closing the door loudly.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“No. This can't be.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No. This can't be.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You!”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel turned to me.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I knew this would happen. I should..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew this would happen. I should've trusted my gut feeling.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Shame on me for actually believing..."
entries.dialogueText: “Shame on me for actually believing we could work together.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I couldn't be more wrong.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I couldn't be more wrong.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Get your hands off of me!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Get your hands off of me!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I played you like a fiddle.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I played you like a fiddle.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's over, Walter.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's over, Walter.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good riddance.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good riddance.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“We will do everything we can to ma..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will do everything we can to make sure you never get a second term.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I will be blunt.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I will be blunt.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Dictator!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Dictator!”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Screw you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Screw you.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel's shoulders slumped in defea..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel's shoulders slumped in defeat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Walter ignored him."
entries.dialogueText: Walter ignored him.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Mr. President. Who are you really..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President. Who are you really doing this for?"

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I had a gut feeling, President. I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had a gut feeling, President. I knew you were not to be trusted.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Give me back my pen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Give me back my pen.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I knew you would end up destroying..."
entries.dialogueText: “I knew you would end up destroying everything Sordland stood for.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“For your sake, I hope I never see..."
entries.dialogueText: “For your sake, I hope I never see your face again."

entries.dialogueText: “I should've destroyed you when I had the chance.”

entries.dialogueText: “Your time will come too, Rayne. Believe me.”

entries.dialogueText: Two guards immediately entered the room.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“You totalist dog!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You totalist dog!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And look at where we are now.”"
entries.dialogueText: “And look at where we are now.”
entries.menuText: “And look at where we are now.”

entries.dialogueText: "I wonder how you'll do that now that you don't have any teeth."

entries.dialogueText: “I wouldn't underestimate what they can do, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti

entries.dialogueText: “This is absolutely ridiculous! I can't do it. I just can't."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“We will never forget what you have..."
entries.dialogueText: “We will never forget what you have done to us.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Marcel got up from his seat and gave me the pen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grabbed the pen from Marcel's ha..."
entries.dialogueText: He grabbed the pen from Marcel's hands and gave it to me.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“You can't do this to me!”"
entries.dialogueText: “You can't do this to me!”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.dialogueText: “Mr. President, we can't let them threaten you like this.”

entries.dialogueText: “Gentlemen, don't make this more difficult.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade

entries.dialogueText: “Sign the papers.”

entries.menuText: “You are right. Guards! Some time in Antel Rock Prison will teach him.”

entries.dialogueText: “Mr. Koronti and Mr. Tusk. I've showed you both what I'm capable of. You will not threaten me... or else."
entries.menuText: “Mr. Koronti and Mr. Tusk. I've showed you both what I'm capable of. You will not threaten me... or else."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Get up, come closer and give me back my pen.”
entries.menuText: “Get up, come closer and give me back my pen.”

entries.title: Player: "“Lucian.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Lucian.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“I don't have a pen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't have a pen.”

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Neither do I.""
entries.dialogueText: “Neither do I."

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Or else what?""
entries.dialogueText: “Or else what?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I handed him my own pen with the Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him my own pen with the Presidential sigil on it.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk

entries.dialogueText: “There is no way out of this, is there?”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“No. No, no, no.""
entries.dialogueText: “No. No, no, no."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel signed the papers."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel signed the papers.

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Do you know who we are?""
entries.dialogueText: “Do you know who we are?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sign it or else.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Sign it or else.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Walter sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Walter sighed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Two guards waiting outside entered..."
entries.dialogueText: Two guards waiting outside entered the room immediately and started to apprehend Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk.

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“I'll tell you this, President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'll tell you this, President.”

entries.speaker: Marcel Koronti
entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Mark my words. Whoever put you up..."
entries.dialogueText: “Mark my words. Whoever put you up to this, I'm sure they'll turn on you one day as well."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk
entries.title: Walter Tusk: "“Fine. I will sign it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Fine. I will sign it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No need for escalation. They don't..."
entries.dialogueText: “No need for escalation. They don't have any power anymore.”
entries.menuText: “No need for escalation. They don't have any power anymore.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In a painfully slow manner, he sign..."
entries.dialogueText: In a painfully slow manner, he signed the documents. He handed my pen to Marcel.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel halfheartedly extended his a..."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel halfheartedly extended his arm across the table. The pen was still too far away to reach.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't need your deal now that I..."
entries.dialogueText: “I don't need your deal now that I have your company.”
entries.menuText: “I don't need your deal now that I have your company.”

entries.dialogueText: “Don't you worry, Lucian. I've launched an investigation that will uncover all of their dirty secrets."
entries.menuText: “Don't you worry, Lucian. I've launched an investigation that will uncover all of their dirty secrets."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Marcel looked at me disbelievingly."
entries.dialogueText: Marcel looked at me disbelievingly.

entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to gather enough evidenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to gather enough evidence to throw you in jail for life."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to gather enough evidence to throw you in jail for life."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You gentlemen can't hide anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gentlemen can't hide anything from me."
entries.menuText: "You gentlemen can't hide anything from me."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk

entries.dialogueText: “Don't underestimate me.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: “I wonder if they will stand by you when you don't have enough money to pay them.”

entries.dialogueText: "Listen, you halfwit. Even if I did have something to hide, I've got an army of lawyers and half the Assembly on my side."

entries.title: Marcel Koronti: "“Or me.""
entries.dialogueText: “Or me."

entries.speaker: Walter Tusk

entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you and your trained monkey in hell."

entries.dialogueText: Lucian didn't move. I saw a muscle in his jaw twitch.

entries.dialogueText: "Marcel, I've had just about enough of Sordland. Wouldn't you say?"

entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't have put it better myself. I hear the weather in Arcasia is lovely this time of year."
